newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia communications industries to be reviewed.
newsitem.headline: Australia communications industries to be reviewed.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday he had asked the Industry Commission to report within nine months on the state of the telecommunications equipment, systems and services industries.

Costello said the inquiry would provide an opportunity to examine the key support industries of the rapidly expanding communications sector and to consider factors affecting the development of those industries.

"I have asked the commission to report on the industries with respect to their current structure and competitiveness, the likely effect of local and global trends, the effect of international trade agreements, and measures which could be undertaken to improve their efficiency and development," he said in a statement.
He said the inquiry would have an economy-wide focus and would be aimed at developing policies for the industries.
The commission would soon release an issues paper on the inquiry, he said.
